topics.chinese_topic: C919国产大飞机正式执飞国际商业航线
topics.official_english: China's C919 begins operating an international commercial route
topics.why_hot: China's homegrown narrow-body jet has reached a new milestone by officially starting service on an international commercial route, drawing national pride and industry attention.
topics.share_angle: Break down what the C919's international commercial service means for Chinese aviation and global competition.

topics.official_english: Multiple localities pilot direct admission to high school
topics.why_hot: Several places are testing policies that let students enter high school without the usual entrance exam, fueling debate over fairness and exam pressure.
topics.share_angle: Explain how the pilot works, what problems it aims to solve, and why it is controversial.

topics.chinese_topic: 郭兰英逝世 享年97岁
topics.official_english: Guo Lanying, legendary Chinese singer, dies at 97
topics.why_hot: Guo Lanying was a revered figure in Chinese music and opera, and her passing at 97 prompted an outpouring of tributes and memories.
topics.share_angle: Highlight her artistic legacy and the 1994 decision to donate her performance copyrights to the state.

topics.chinese_topic: 梁文锋跻身全球最富有50人之列
topics.official_english: Liang Wenfeng ranks among the world's 50 richest people
topics.why_hot: A Chinese entrepreneur's appearance in a global top-50 wealth ranking sparked discussion about wealth creation and the technology economy.
topics.share_angle: Examine what the ranking reflects about China's tech sector and the public response to new wealth.

topics.chinese_topic: 月12日地球将失重7秒系谣言
topics.official_english: Claim that Earth will lose gravity for 7 seconds on August 12 is a rumor
topics.why_hot: A viral online claim about a seven-second loss of gravity on Aug 12 has been widely debunked, showing how quickly space misinformation spreads.
topics.share_angle: Use the rumor as a chance to explain gravity and how to verify viral science claims.

topics.chinese_topic: 赵一鸣4块牛肉干64元复称仅17元
topics.official_english: Beef jerky at Zhao Yiming snack store priced at 64 yuan but reweighed at 17 yuan draws scrutiny
topics.why_hot: A consumer complained that four pieces of beef jerky were charged as 64 yuan but a recheck showed about 17 yuan, triggering anger over possible short weighting.
topics.share_angle: Show consumers how to check bulk-food weights and explain the legal standards for weighing in stores.

topics.chinese_topic: 四个年轻人拍语文课本单条播放破亿

topics.why_hot: A short video recreating scenes from Chinese-language textbooks has resonated with viewers, surpassing 100 million plays and sparking nostalgia.
topics.share_angle: Discuss the power of textbook memories and how young creators are turning school culture into viral content.
